rules.text: All table sizes and shapes are available in High-Pressure Laminate with 3 mm edge. Most sizes and shapes are also available in High-Pressure Laminate with P-edge or in wood veneer with square edge (see specifying pages for N.A. cells).
Wood veneer capsule tables are available in 72"W, 84"W, and 96"W only.
Wood veneer square tables are available in 30"W, 42"W, 48"W, and 54"W only.
Oval tables are available in 3 mm edge High-Pressure Laminate only.
Hex conference tables are available in 3 mm edge High-Pressure Laminate only.
Table top has a wood core with a High-Pressure Laminate or wood veneer surface and is 13/16" thick.
Knife edge with 3 mm user edge is available on straight and tapered systems worksurfaces and on round tables (the only Universal Table with a K suffix is the round table).
Edge profile finishes are specified separately from laminate color. PVC-free 3 mm edge profiles are a polyolefin blend for all solid colors and seven woodgrain finishes.
Wood veneer tables: edges available in square (3 mm) profile only (SW suffix).

HPL tables: laminate; Open Line laminate (option). 3 mm or P-edge profile: plastic. Wood veneer tables: wood veneer (standard), Customiz stain (option), Full-fill finish (option); square (3 mm) edge: wood veneer to match table.

Style number suffix selects edge: no suffix = plastic 3 mm edge; P = laminate with plastic P-edge; K = laminate with knife edge (round tables only); SW = wood with square edge. Price for suffixed style is the absolute price in that edge column (not an add). N.A. cells mean the variant is not offered.
Plastic color number for edge must be specified on laminate tables.
Full-fill finish is available only on wood veneer tables; price is added per row (Option column) to the base price.
Premium wood 2 / Premium wood 3 pricing is not printed; refer to the electronic catalog or SmartTools.
Universal tables are supported by bases or legs, which are ordered separately and installed in the field.
Not all sizes and shapes of tables can be supported by bases or by legs; use the Table and Base Combinations (page 243) and Table and Leg Combinations (page 244) matrices.

Reinforcing channels are available to support tables wider than 60"W that are supported by legs; option offered on 66"W and wider straight, transition, capsule and rectangle tables at no cost. When installed, channels add 1" below the table. Channels are field installed.
Select the reinforcing channel option if the table will be supported by legs. Channels are not required if the table is 96" or smaller and will be supported by T- or X-bases.
Channels are required and are always included with tables 120" and larger (hex conference 120"W+).
Cabby legs can be positioned in a 45° or 90° orientation. Post legs are positioned in 45° orientation only.
Elliptical leg installed in the first inset position may only be in a 45° orientation. Single post legs can only be installed in a 45° orientation.
Legs may be installed inset from the edge of the table 3", 6", or 9" (positions 1, 2, 3) to accommodate slip-fit planning; amount of slip-fit varies by table shape and size.

Table with 28 1/2"H legs installed at 6" or 9" inset can slip over adjacent tables that are supported with 26"H legs. 26"H legs allow tables to nest underneath an adjacent table with 28 1/2"H legs or a panel-mounted worksurface.
Adjustable-height legs adjust 25 1/2"H to 31 1/2"H in 3/4" increments; can support a table in standard height or nesting application.
52"W or 64"W spanners should be used when tables are separated by a panel or Post and Beam. Spanner table enables conferencing at the end of two tables placed back-to-back.

Mobile pedestals up to 24 1/2"H will fit under 26"H tables without reinforcing channels. Mobile pedestals up to 27"H will fit under 28 1/2"H tables without reinforcing channels. Tables with reinforcing channel reduce the available space by 1".
Dimensions on straight and transition tables are 1/4" less than nominal (e.g. a 48"W x 72"W corner is actually 47 3/4"W x 71 3/4"W) to allow easy fit in panel-wrapped environments.

Screens can be used on corner, 120° tables: 24"W screens on tables with C and D each equal to 43"; 24"W and 30"W screens on tables with C and D each equal to 49". Corner, 120° tables with C and D each equal to 37" (BFB223636) cannot accommodate screens.

Identical worksurfaces ordered on the same line item are packed on pallets of 5-50 depending on size; if palletizing is not desired, order in quantities of four or less per line item. Wood veneer worksurfaces cannot be palletized.
Hex conference tables 150"W or larger are shipped in two pieces; tight-joint fasteners are supplied.
Tables and bases are ordered separately. Bases are available 26"W and 36"W, 27 9/16"H, T-base or X-base; shipped knocked down (K.D.) and require assembly. Adjustable leveling glides included.
Base surface materials: column and base paint (standard) or 9201 Polished Chrome (option). Polished chrome base only requires a paint color for the column.
Legs support tables at 26"H or 28 1/2"H overall, including table thickness. Table legs are ordered separately and installed on site. Table legs are non-handed.

Table legs cannot be used in a shared application with two tables (radius corners do not provide enough attachment space for leg plate). When a shared leg application is required, order Universal Systems Worksurfaces.

Cabby leg and adjustable-height legs are available with locking casters or glides; post legs with non-locking casters or glides; elliptical leg in glide version only (nesting or desk-height); double post C-leg is an individual support used at the ends of a table.
Glide range: cabby 3/4", adjustable-height 3/4", elliptical 5/8", post 3/4", double post C-leg 5/8".

Leg finishes: Cabby legs 4743 Mineral Metallic, 4750 Champagne Metallic, 4798 Sterling Metallic, 4799 Platinum Metallic, 7207 Black, 7225 Sand, 7239 Midnight. Adjustable-height legs 4750, 4798, 4799, 7207, 7225, 7239. Elliptical leg paint or 9201 Polished Chrome; elliptical glide 7207 Black, 7230 Basalt, 8042 Brushed Aluminum, 8046 Polished Aluminum. Post, post with caster and double post C-legs: paint. Post leg caster: black plastic.
Corner tables require a leg in the back corner. Be sure to order fifth leg if specifying a package of four.
Paint price group upcharges on legs are per leg (+$19 group 2; post legs +$32 group 3).
Use 26"H elliptical legs (BEL25) for nesting capabilities and 28 1/2"H (BEL27) to achieve standard height tables.
Straight tables 24"D x 36"W (BFS2436): order 1 x BX26 (26"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Straight tables 30"D x 36"W–42"W (BFS3036, BFS3042): order 1 x BX36 (36"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Straight tables 30"D x 48"W–78"W (BFS3048, BFS3054, BFS3060, BFS3066, BFS3072, BFS3078): order 2 x BT26 (26"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Capsule tables 24"D x 48"W (BFK2448): order 2 x BX26 (26"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Capsule tables 30"D x 60"W, 36"D x 72"W (BFK3060, BFK3672): order 2 x BT26 (26"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Capsule tables 42"D x 84"W, 48"D x 96"W (BFK4284, BFK4896): order 2 x BT36 (36"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Round tables 30" and 36" diameter (BFR30, BFR36): order 1 x BX26 (26"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Round tables 42", 48", 54" diameter (BFR42, BFR48, BFR54): order 1 x BX36 (36"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Square tables 30"D x 30"W (BFRQ30): order 1 x BX26 (26"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Square tables 36"D x 36"W, 42"D x 42"W (BFRQ36, BFRQ42): order 1 x BX36 (36"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Square tables 48"D x 48"W, 54"D x 54"W (BFRQ48, BFRQ54): order 2 x BT36 (36"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Rectangle tables 36"D x 60"W, 66"W, 72"W (BFRR3660, BFRR3666, BFRR3672): order 2 x BT26 (26"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Rectangle tables 42"D x 84"W, 48"D x 96"W (BFRR4284, BFRR4896): order 2 x BT36 (36"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Oval tables 30"D x 42"W (BEL3042): order 1 x BX26 (26"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Oval tables 36"D x 48"W (BEL3648): order 1 x BX36 (36"W X-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Oval tables 30"D x 60"W, 36"D x 72"W, 42"D x 78"W (BEL3060, BEL3672, BEL4278): order 2 x BT26 (26"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Oval tables 48"D x 96"W (BEL4896): order 2 x BT36 (36"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Hex conference tables 36"D x 60"W, 66"W, 72"W (BHEX3660, BHEX3666, BHEX3672): order 2 x BT26 (26"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Hex conference tables 42"D x 96"W (BHEX4296): order 2 x BT36 (36"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.
Hex conference tables 48"D x 120"W, 150"W, 180"W (BHEX48120, BHEX48150, BHEX48180): order 3 x BT36 (36"W T-base). This is the only valid base for these sizes.

Blank spaces in the matrix designate invalid table/base combinations. No base is valid for: straight 24"D tables other than 24"x36" (BFS2430, BFS2442–BFS2478), square 24"x24" (BFRQ24), oval 21"x42" (BEL2142), and all transition, corner 120°, spanner, peninsula, tapered peninsula and bubble jetty tables.
Straight tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs, or 2 double post C-legs (BCL).
Transition tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs, or 2 double post C-legs (BCL). Do not apply a double post C-leg to a 36"D side.
Corner, 120° tables: order 5 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs. Alternatively supported by one post leg and two double post C-legs.
Round tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs.
Square tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs.
Rectangle tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs.
Spanner tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs.
Capsule tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs.
Peninsula tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs.
Tapered peninsula tables: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs.
Bubble jetty tables: order 5 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs. Double post C-leg can only be applied to the square end of bubble jetty tables (quantity not printed).

Oval tables, up to 36"D x 72"W: order 4 cabby, adjustable-height, elliptical or post legs. Oval tables 21"D x 42"W and 30"D x 42"W may only use legs with glides; legs with casters may not be used on these sizes.
Hex conference tables and oval tables 42"D x 78"W and larger (BEL4278, BEL4896, all BHEX) can only be supported with T-bases (no legs).
See Post and Beam Solutions Specification Guide for tethered capsule tables support information.
Blank spaces in matrix designate table and leg combinations that are not valid.
Straight 24"D x 30"W: available leg positions [1] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: both 45° and 90°.
Straight 24"D x 36"W, 30"D x 36"W, 30"D x 42"W: available leg positions [1, 2] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: both 45° and 90°.
Straight 24"D and 30"D x 48"W–78"W: available leg positions [1, 2, 3] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: both 45° and 90°.
Transition: available leg positions [1, 2, 3] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: both 45° and 90°; positions 1-2 at one end, 1-2-3 at the other end per drawing.
Corner, 120°: available leg positions [1, 2, 3] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: end legs both 45° and 90° (positions 1-3); back-corner leg single orientation.
Round 30", 36", 42", 48" diameter: available leg positions [1] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: single orientation (45° or 90° as drawn).
Round 54" diameter: available leg positions [1, 2] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: single orientation.
Square 24"x24", 30"x30": available leg positions [1] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: both 45° and 90°.
Square 36"–54": available leg positions [1, 2] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: single orientation (drawn at 45°).
Rectangle: available leg positions [1, 2] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: single orientation (drawn at 45°).
Spanner: available leg positions [1] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: straight-edge legs both; curved-edge legs single.
Capsule 24"x48", 30"x60": available leg positions [1] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: single orientation.
Capsule 36"x72", 42"x84", 48"x96": available leg positions [1, 2] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: single orientation.
Peninsula: available leg positions [1] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: straight-edge legs both; curved-edge legs single.
Tapered peninsula: available leg positions [1, 2, 3] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: square end positions 1-3 both; round end position 1 only, single orientation.
Bubble jetty: available leg positions [1, 2, 3] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: square end positions 1-3 both; bubble end position 1 only, single orientation.
Oval 21"x42", 30"x42", 36"x48", 30"x60", 36"x72": available leg positions [1] (position 1 = 3", 2 = 6", 3 = 9" from edge); orientation: single orientation.
Positions 2 and 3 are not available on every table. Legend: one symbol = both 45° and 90° available at that position; other symbol = either 45° or 90° (single orientation).

All knit screens mount in two positions: on top of clamp for desktop privacy, or on underside of clamp for below-worksurface modesty. Clamps are ordered separately (DSCLAMP pair). Overall height from floor in privacy position is 43 1/2"H.
Gap between 15"H screen and top of worksurface is 1" (privacy); gap between bottom of worksurface and screen is 1 1/2" (modesty).

Multiple screens can share clamps; three clamps can support screens of various sizes. Screens can be planned to match worksurface width; if worksurfaces are slip-fit, screen sizes must be planned accordingly.
Clamps attach to worksurfaces 1 1/8" to 1 3/16" thick (Universal Worksurfaces and Tables, Answer, and Ellipse). Clamps cannot be used with Series 9000 and Avenir 1 1/2" thick worksurfaces.

For corner privacy (screens on back and side), the side screen should be specified 6" smaller: e.g. 30"D x 42"W worksurface with a 38 1/4"W (DALK42) back screen requires a 20 1/4"W (DALK24) side screen.

For corner 120° tables: 20 1/4"W screens (DALK24) can be used on tables with C and D each 43"; 20 1/4"W and 26 1/4"W screens (DALK24, DALK30) on tables with C and D each 49"; C and D 37" cannot accommodate screens.

15"H screens can be used on fences in Post and Beam applications (attachment hardware in Post and Beam Solutions Specification Guide). Knit colors: B902 Soft White, B903 Fog, B904 Sand; frame/foot and clamp 4799 Platinum only; clamp knob and cover 7237 Slate only.

Divisio side screen is magnetic, user-movable; may be used on any 3/4"- to 1 1/2"-thick worksurface that is 24"D or deeper (21 1/2" sits on the worksurface). Intended for front of worksurface; 8" overhang; ~14 1/2 lb; does not work on knife edge profiles.

Power and data strip (specifying page 556, outside this section) provides three simplex receptacles and space for customer-supplied voice/data outlets; field-installed on a worksurface or on slatwall with the appropriate attachment bracket (worksurface bracket fits worksurfaces 59/64" to 1 5/8" thick). 8'-long cord with plug. Chicago, New York City and Los Angeles have special requirements. Finish 8043 Clear Anodized aluminum cover with black faceplate; brackets 4799 Platinum paint only.
